# PrismaticConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("PrismaticConstraint")`

A joint that lets two parts slide along one line and nothing else, such as a lift, a drawer or a piston. The line is the X axis of the attachments, so rotating an attachment aims the rail. With an actuator the joint moves by itself: a `Motor` holds a speed, and a `Servo` moves to a position and stays there.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ActuatorType` | `Enum.ActuatorType` | `Enum.ActuatorType.None` | read/write | Whether the joint drives itself. `None` does nothing, `Motor` moves at a constant speed, and `Servo` moves to a position and holds it. |
| `Damping` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: how strongly the joint resists moving, in newton seconds per meter. Used together with `Stiffness`. Critical damping, which reaches the target without overshooting, is `2 * math.sqrt(Stiffness * m)` for a mass of `m` kilograms. Less overshoots and oscillates; more arrives slowly. |
| `LimitsEnabled` | `boolean` | `false` | read/write | Whether `LowerLimit` and `UpperLimit` apply. When it is off, the joint slides without limit. |
| `LinearResponsiveness` | `number` | `45` | read/write | For `Servo`: how quickly the joint closes the last of the distance to its target, as a frequency in radians per second. Used only when `Stiffness` is 0. The joint arrives without overshooting. The value is tuned for the two parts on the rail. |
| `LowerLimit` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The lower limit of the slide, in meters from the position where the parts were joined. |
| `MotorMaxAcceleration` | `number` | `100000` | read/write | For `Motor`: how quickly the motor's speed can change, in meters per second squared. |
| `MotorMaxForce` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | For `Motor`: the largest force the motor can apply, in newtons. |
| `ServoMaxForce` | `number` | `10000` | read/write | For `Servo`: the largest force the servo can apply to reach its target and hold it, in newtons. A load that needs more than this is not moved. |
| `Speed` | `number` | `100000` | read/write | For `Servo`: the highest speed the joint moves at on its way to the target, in meters per second. Near the target, the spring takes over. |
| `Stiffness` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: the strength of the spring that pulls the joint to its target, in newtons per meter. At 0, `LinearResponsiveness` is used instead. Above 0, this and `Damping` set the response. For a load of `m` kilograms, `w * w * m` gives a response of `w` radians per second. |
| `TargetPosition` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Servo`: the position the joint moves to, in meters along the rail from where the parts were joined. |
| `UpperLimit` | `number` | `5` | read/write | The upper limit of the slide, in meters from the position where the parts were joined. If `LowerLimit` is greater than `UpperLimit`, the slide is not limited. |
| `Velocity` | `number` | `0` | read/write | For `Motor`: the speed the joint moves at, in meters per second along the rail. |
